authority: Per-image object-position for the live board's three slots. build-events-feed.mjs merges this into events.json as `crops`; the board applies it inline per . Without an entry an image gets the slot's blanket CSS default, which is what shipped beheaded dancers for weeks.
how: 2. Look at every proposal. Automated face detection is not proof (photo-directions.json).
3. Copy the ones that actually read better into this file, with `verified` and a note.
4. Re-run SYNC-TO-GITHUB.command so the feed carries them.
